amendment: Before any human enrollment: correct F11's unsupported Nor substring assumption to source-backed Kingdom / Kongeriket partial alias tokens, after an exposed AI adapter rehearsal. No human sessions are affected. Recruitment, task order, rubric, thresholds, UI/source commit and datasets are unchanged. Schema version remains 1; forms bind the new freeze hash and cannot mix with the superseded protocol.
recruitment: Voluntary adults who plausibly explore RDF for analysis/research; include beginners and experienced RDF users and Norwegian/English proficiency; convenience sample, no schedule promised
gemet_reason: Keep first pilot small: Wikidata and GeoNames-derived RDF plus separately labelled synthetic ambiguity/shared-path cases
training: Show launch/controls on Q20, unscored; record assistance on every later task. Fixed order and overlaps cause learning; not independent tasks.

rubric.confidence: Explicit participant 1 not confident to 5 very confident; null if declined
rubric.relevance: Find only, participant 1 not relevant to 5 very relevant; null if declined; never top-k accuracy
rubric.success: Completed with every required check true and actual assessor; assistance reported separately; deliberate cancellation may succeed
rubric.confident_wrong: Confidence >=4 and at least one observed false rubric check or wrong decision; unassessed confidence remains visible
rubric.time: Operator elapsed whole seconds; include assistance; no timestamps or keystroke traces
rubric.missing: Missing records and not_attempted tasks stay in planned denominator; no success inferred
rubric.abandoned_excluded: Keep attempted, time, assistance and any observed failures; never successful
rubric.review: All task references AI-authored; no human review claimed. Actual local assessor ID and role required for judgments; no names published
